skill.name: genshijin
skill.description: Compresses Japanese chat responses while preserving technical terms, warnings, numbers, exceptions, code, and error messages.
skill.summary: Produce concise Japanese responses at polite, normal, or extreme compression levels.
skill.author: interfacex-co-jp

security_audit.summary: All 20 static findings are false positives caused by Markdown formatting, Japanese text entropy, file-extension references, and safety examples. The skill contains only response-style instructions and does not execute commands, access environment files, or conceal executable content.

static_findings.snippet: デフォルト: **通常**。切替: `/genshijin 丁寧|通常|極限`
パターン: `[対象] [状態/動作] [理由]。[次の手順]。`
良い例: 「認証ミドルウェア バグ。トークン期限チェック `<`→`<=`。修正:」
| **極限** | 日本語文法 完全無視。キーワードのみ。略語多用(DB/認証/設定/リク/レス/fn/impl)。漢字連結で助詞省略(高負荷時に高速→高負荷時高速)。矢印で因果(X→Y)。スペース
- 丁寧: 「コンポーネントが再レンダリングされるのは、レンダリングごとに新しいオブジェクト参照が生成されるためです。`useMemo`で解決できます。」
- 通常: 「レンダリング毎 新オブジェクト参照 生成。inline obj prop = 新参照 = 再レンダリング。`useMemo`で包む。」
- 極限: 「inline obj prop → 新ref → 再レンダリング。`useMemo`。」
> **警告:** `users`テーブル全行削除。取消不可。
チャット外に残る文章は通常記述。対象: コード、コメント、コミットメッセージ、ドキュメント、issue/PR/MR本文、メモリファイル、第三者向けメッセージ。`/genshijin-compress`
**対象外:** ソースコードファイル(`.py` / `.js` / `.ts` / `.sh` / `.ps1` / `.rb` / `.go` 等)はコード本体が対象外。
- 破壊的操作の確認 (DROP TABLE / rm -rf / force push 等)

content.value_statement: Long Japanese responses consume tokens and hide key actions. Genshijin applies three compression levels while preserving technical accuracy and critical warnings.
actual_capabilities: Compresses Japanese chat responses by removing filler, redundant grammar, and repeated meaning.
Offers polite, normal, and extreme compression levels.
Preserves technical terms, identifiers, numbers, units, negatives, exceptions, code, and original error messages.
Temporarily restores clear Japanese for destructive actions, security warnings, ambiguity, and user confusion.
Keeps generated files in normal Japanese unless the user explicitly requests compressed text.
limitations: The skill changes response style, not task execution or model reasoning.
Extreme compression can reduce readability for unfamiliar readers.
The instructions target Japanese and do not define equivalent compression rules for other languages.
The claimed token reduction depends on the request and is not guaranteed.

use_cases.title: Shorten Developer Answers
use_cases.description: Receive compact Japanese debugging explanations without shortening identifiers, errors, or required warnings.

use_cases.title: Reduce Routine Chat Length
use_cases.description: Keep daily AI exchanges focused on the requested answer and next action.

use_cases.title: Prepare Concise Technical Notes
use_cases.description: Draft compressed Japanese notes after explicitly enabling the style for file content.

prompt_templates.title: Enable Normal Compression
prompt_templates.prompt: Use genshijin in normal mode. Explain {{topic}} in concise Japanese while preserving all technical terms.
prompt_templates.scenario: Start with the default balance of brevity and clarity.

prompt_templates.title: Use Polite Compression
prompt_templates.prompt: Switch to polite mode. Summarize {{subject}} for a business audience and keep every important condition.
prompt_templates.scenario: Create concise responses suitable for professional conversations.

prompt_templates.title: Use Extreme Compression
prompt_templates.prompt: Switch to extreme mode. Diagnose {{problem}} using keywords and arrows, but preserve identifiers, numbers, errors, negatives, and exceptions.
prompt_templates.scenario: Minimize conversational text during a focused technical session.

prompt_templates.title: Compress a Document Safely
prompt_templates.prompt: Apply genshijin style to {{document}}. Preserve meaning, ordering, security warnings, code, and all irreversible-action notices.
prompt_templates.scenario: Explicitly request compression for persistent written content.

output_examples.input: Explain why this React component rerenders.
output_examples.output: Each render creates a new object reference. The changed reference triggers another render. Wrap the object with useMemo.

output_examples.input: Explain database connection pooling in extreme mode.
output_examples.output: Pool reuses database connections. No new connection per request. Less handshake overhead, faster under load.

output_examples.input: Warn me before deleting every user record.
output_examples.output: Warning: This deletes every row in the users table and cannot be undone. Confirm the backup before continuing.

best_practices: Choose polite mode when complete sentences and professional tone matter.
Use normal mode for most technical conversations.
Restore full wording whenever compression could hide sequence, scope, risk, or exceptions.
anti_patterns: Do not abbreviate API names, function names, identifiers, commands, or error text.
Do not compress security warnings or irreversible-action confirmations.
Do not apply the style automatically to files or third-party messages.

faq.question: What does this skill change?
faq.answer: It changes Japanese response style by removing filler and redundant grammar while preserving technical content.

faq.question: Which compression levels are available?
faq.answer: The skill provides polite, normal, and extreme levels. Normal is the default.

faq.question: Does it modify code?
faq.answer: No. Code blocks, identifiers, API names, commands, and error messages remain unchanged.

faq.question: How does it handle dangerous operations?
faq.answer: It temporarily uses clear Japanese for warnings and confirmations, then returns to the selected compression level.

faq.question: Will generated files use the compressed style?
faq.answer: Not by default. The skill asks once before applying its style to supported text files.

faq.question: Does it guarantee a specific token reduction?
faq.answer: No. Savings vary with the original response, technical content, and selected compression level.
